setup: PRAGMA encoding='UTF-8'
CREATE TABLE t(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,a TEXT,n NUMERIC,v)
CREATE INDEX i_nc ON t(a COLLATE NOCASE)
CREATE INDEX i_bin ON t(a COLLATE BINARY)
CREATE INDEX i_num ON t(n)
WITH RECURSIVE x(i) AS (VALUES(20) UNION ALL SELECT i+1 FROM x WHERE i<519) INSERT INTO t SELECT i,printf('zz%04d',i),i,NULL FROM x
ANALYZE

cases.sql: SELECT id,a,n,v FROM t WHERE a LIKE 'abc%' ORDER BY id

eqp: SEARCH t USING INDEX i_nc (a>? AND a<?)
USE TEMP B-TREE FOR ORDER BY

cases.sql: SELECT id,a,n,v FROM t INDEXED BY i_nc WHERE a LIKE 'abc%' ORDER BY id

eqp: SEARCH t USING INDEX i_nc (a>? AND a<?)
USE TEMP B-TREE FOR ORDER BY

cases.sql: SELECT id,a,n,v FROM t NOT INDEXED WHERE a LIKE 'abc%' ORDER BY id

eqp: SCAN t

cases.sql: SELECT id,a,n,v FROM t WHERE a GLOB 'abc*' ORDER BY id

eqp: SEARCH t USING INDEX i_bin (a>? AND a<?)
USE TEMP B-TREE FOR ORDER BY

cases.sql: SELECT id,a,n,v FROM t INDEXED BY i_bin WHERE a GLOB 'abc*' ORDER BY id

eqp: SEARCH t USING INDEX i_bin (a>? AND a<?)
USE TEMP B-TREE FOR ORDER BY

cases.sql: SELECT id,a,n,v FROM t NOT INDEXED WHERE a GLOB 'abc*' ORDER BY id

eqp: SCAN t

cases.sql: SELECT id,a,n,v FROM t WHERE a LIKE 'ab!_%' ESCAPE '!' ORDER BY id

eqp: SEARCH t USING INDEX i_nc (a>? AND a<?)
USE TEMP B-TREE FOR ORDER BY

eqp: SEARCH t USING INDEX i_nc (a>? AND a<?)
USE TEMP B-TREE FOR ORDER BY

eqp: SCAN t

eqp: SCAN t USING INDEX i_nc
USE TEMP B-TREE FOR ORDER BY

cases.sql: SELECT id,a,n,v FROM t WHERE n LIKE '12%' ORDER BY id

eqp: SCAN t

cases.sql: SELECT id,a,n,v FROM t WHERE n GLOB '-a*' ORDER BY id

eqp: SEARCH t USING INDEX i_num (n>? AND n<?)

SEARCH y USING INTEGER PRIMARY KEY (rowid=?) LEFT-JOIN
